greetingReply.en: Hi! I'm the STARGO WORK assistant. Ask me about product features, deployment or how rollout works. A colleague handles pricing and payment; type "talk to a human" any time to reach a person. If it is urgent, email sales@stargogrowth.com or reach us by phone, WeChat or WhatsApp at +86 187 7512 7878.
